name: Hinte MTSS 2024 — abdominal visceral adipose tissue
description: snRNA-seq dataset of pooled omental adipose tissue biopsies from individuals undergoing weight loss via two-step bariatric surgery and their age matched lean individuals (cohort MTSS)

labelsets.name: author_cell_type
labelsets.description: Annotation of all broad canonical cell populations present in AT were based on previously described markers from Emont et al. 2022 (PMID: 35296864), Massier et al 2023 (PMID: 36922516), Maniyadath (PMID: 36889280), Sárvári et al 2021 (PMID: 33378646), Shan et al 2020 (PMID: 33139957), Schwalie et al (PMID: 29925944).

labels.name: FAPs
labels.rationale: Marker genes for each cell population in the human WAT dataset (Extended Data Fig. 2a of publication). Based on previously described markers from from Emont et al. 2022 (PMID: 35296864), Massier et al 2023 (PMID: 36922516), Maniyadath (PMID: 36889280), Sárvári et al 2021 (PMID: 33378646), Shan et al 2020 (PMID: 33139957), Schwalie et al (PMID: 29925944).
synonyms: mesenchymal stem cell of adipose tissue
